pkgmetadata.longdescription: Yandex Browser corporate edition: a Chromium-based browser with Yandex services and enterprise policy support. Installed from the official Yandex Debian package under /opt/yandex/browser.

use.flag: Install a symlink to the system Chromium ffmpeg build (media-video/ffmpeg-chromium:152) so that H.264/AAC playback works.
